content.heading: Repeal and savings
content.text: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is repealed. Notwithstanding such repeal, if there is any appeal, application, trial, inquiry or investigation pending before the date of commencement of this Sanhita, such appeal, application, trial, inquiry or investigation shall be disposed of, continued, held or made, as the case may be, in accordance with the provisions of the said Code, as if this Sanhita had not come into force. Read the official savings clauses.
